items.title: There's no time to improvise when an engine fails over high terrain. The aircraft can't hold its cruising level, and the crew needs to know right now which way to turn and how low
items.summary: There's no time to improvise when an engine fails over high terrain. The aircraft can't hold its cruising level, and the crew needs to know right now which way to turn and how low they can safely go. Airlines plan for this. Flight Ops Engineers prepare escape routes for terrain-critical segments, per aircraft type and per failure: a depressurisation route to get down quickly, a drift-down route to keep terrain clearance after an engine failure. items.title: Royal Air Maroc has signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip pilots across its fleet with AvioBook Flight, an Electronic Flight Bag platform designed to streamline flight
items.summary: Royal Air Maroc has signed a five-year agreement with Thales to equip pilots across its fleet with AvioBook Flight, an Electronic Flight Bag platform designed to streamline flight workflows, support fuel optimisation and improve coordination between crews and ground teams. The deal comes as the Moroccan carrier targets a fleet of 200 aircraft by 2037, placing greater emphasis on operational systems that can support growth.
